notes: Mazemind Tome, printed: '{2}, {T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Draw a card.' and 'When there are four or more page counters ... exile it.' The Tome starts with two page counters; the draw ability costs exactly {2} (C:2 pays, the pool is empty after), draws one card (hand 0 -> 1) and puts the third counter: three is not four or more, so the Tome stays on the battlefield and no life is gained.
